entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello, Alex. I... I need to make a return for my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm hoping you can help me.

I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number? And just to be clear, is there a technical fault with the device, or is this more of a preference issue?
The name is Sarah Jenkins, order number is VF88761. There's nothing wrong with it... I just... I feel a bit silly. It was a total impulse buy.
I see. So the VeloBand is working correctly, but you're not finding it suitable for your needs?

Honestly, I've just changed my mind. I thought I would be using it every day, but I really don't use it at all. I know it's been a couple of weeks, but I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I was really hoping for some flexibility. The money would really help right now.

I understand completely. Let me just pull up your order details and our current policy... okay, I see the order VF88761 was delivered on January 3rd, which was 20 days ago. And let me check the policy here...

Alright, Ms. Jenkins, I've got good news. Our policy states that you have 90 days from the date of delivery for a full refund, as long as the item is in its original condition. Since you're only on day 20, you are well within that window.
Oh! Really? Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I had missed the deadline. That is such a relief. Thank you, Alex.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just pack it up in the original box and drop it off at any post office.
That's perfect. You've really made my day. Thank you so much for being so understanding.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for your VeloFit products?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
